questions.prompt: What is a personal improvement commitment?
options: A vague promise to become better
A specific decision to improve a behaviour or skill through consistent action

questions.prompt: Which statement is the strongest improvement commitment?
options: I will never make another mistake.
For the next 30 days, I will confirm important appointment changes with affected colleagues.

questions.prompt: What should an employee do after failing to practise an improvement commitment?
options: Acknowledge the setback, reflect and resume the commitment

questions.prompt: What does SMART help employees create?
options: Specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound goals

questions.prompt: What is the best approach to selecting improvement commitments?
options: Try to change every behaviour immediately
Choose goals only to impress management
Select a few meaningful priorities and practise them consistently
